## Synthetic job walk

Walk this job after each phase, as far as the built pages reach.

8. Design basis and released materials: EN-02 (phase 05, built; owner review pending), EN-06 (phase 05, built; owner review pending).
9. Materials purchased, received and delivered: SC-02 (phase 05, built; owner review pending), SC-04 (phase 05, built; owner review pending), SC-06 (phase 05, built; owner review pending), SC-07 (phase 05, built; owner review pending).
10. Installed, commissioned and accepted: EN-08 (phase 05, built; owner review pending), FI-03 (phase 04, built; owner review pending), PJ-09 (phase 05, to refine).

15. Management reporting: RP-01 (phase 08, to build).
